title: This year truly exceeded my expectations- so thank you to everyone wh...
transcript: Welcome to my 2024 TikTok wrapped. I wanted to make this little wrap up video to go through all of my TikTok analytics for the year to look back on everything that I posted, how well it performed, and see everything that I accomplished this year. So first off, just some high level stats. I posted 311 videos. If you do the math on that, that's about 6 videos per week, or 7.8 hours of content. Looking at post per month, as you can see, I started the year on a downward trend that kind of culminated in March where I only posted five videos. Was feeling a little bit burnt out at that point, but picked it right back up in June. And then in September had my highest month ever with 48 posts in the month, and since September have maintained 30 to 40 videos a month. Moving on to engagement. I started the year with 4,269 followers and I am ending the year with 17,180 followers, which is bonkers to me. My goal coming into 2024 was to hit 10 k by the end of the year, and y'all absolutely blew that out of the water. So thank you to everyone who has followed along, whether it was this year, last year, whenever. I really appreciate you. And then in addition to followers, I got 35 million views, 2.7 million likes, and 74,000 comments. Crazy. Looking at my followers per month, as you can see I was only gaining A couple hundred followers each month up until June when I had a huge spike in followers. I got a little over 3,000 followers in June, and we'll talk a little bit later about why that was, but after that I saw a dip in July and August. I have heard that when you monetize your channel you see a dip in your engagement at first, so I speculate that's what that was as I monetized my channel in July, but followers definitely picked back up in September and have remained pretty steady since with 1 to 2,000 followers per month. Looking at views per month, it's very similar to the last graph with minimal views in the first couple months. A big spike in June, a dip in July and August, and then in September the views kind of come back. June was my highest at 8.2 million and August was my lowest at 595,000. Which brings us to the top videos of the year by views. At No.. 5, I have the video of Lara Bell Bundy singing popular, which got about 1.1 million views. This was posted in November. At No.. 4, I have my wicked trailer breakdown. This was posted back in February and was my first video to ever hit over a million. Currently has 1.2 million views and is also the only video on this list that is just me talking. It's not someone else's performance. So this video is kind of special to me. At No. 3. I have the video of Sarah Highland and Andrew Barth Feldman singing in Times Square which was posted back in September at No.. 2. I have the video of Anne Hathaway singing somebody to love at the Broadway for Harris event. And then my number one video blowing all of these out of the water is my cabaret compilation of the three M C's. That video posted in June that LED to that huge follower spike as well as that huge spike in views. This currently has 7.8 million views and is by far my most viewed TikTok ever. And so with that, I just wanna end with a big thank you to all of you who have watched this year, who have commented, liked, followed, engaged with my content. I really, really appreciate it. Thanks to I was able to monetize my content this year, which has been a huge game changer for me. It has also LED to me being invited to events and shows that I otherwise would not have been invited to. Who knows what 2025 will bring with TikTok, but I will be here until the ship goes down. But thanks again for watching and I will see you in the next one!
